adaptive_choice_note: E3B was chosen because of E3A finding 6 and the post hoc derivation T7/T8 (gt-e3a-reflection.md sections 2 and 4, commit 1e5ebc3); it is not independent confirmation and E3A is unchanged
clocks: as E3A; attachment margins in both clocks

comparisons.F1_margin_shift: for each cell and N, the change (neutralised minus original) of the raw, ceiling-normalised and null-density-standardised attachment margins and the detached fraction, both clocks; whether any sigma>0 family's margin becomes positive once the floor is removed
comparisons.F2_orientation: change of handover index, partner index and irreversible flux (T8 fixes the affinities, not the aggregate)
comparisons.F3_sign_structure: whether the floor's effect on attachment has the sign opposite to sigma in every path family (from T7/T8: against attachment for sigma>0)

controls_and_identities.C1: CLOSEW and NULL (no path component): every channel unchanged (<= 1e-12)
controls_and_identities.C2: PCOMP (floor on formation and dissolution, equal): every channel unchanged (<= 1e-9)
controls_and_identities.K: the neutralised kernel equals the original on every non-attachment slot (ratio deviation <= 1e-15)
controls_and_identities.T7: every attachment slot has exactly two wholly-internal source witnesses in every reachable state; every probe-probe slot has none
controls_and_identities.T8: max |A_neutralised - A_original| <= 1e-12 over every intact elementary square; the neutralised kernel also satisfies the square identity
controls_and_identities.Z5: per kernel: stationary resolved and residual, GTH referee, long-double residual, symmetry; kernel sample check (rule strings) on the original
controls_and_identities.separation_note: T7, T8, K, C1 and C2 are identities; nothing predicts the size or sign of any margin, index or flux change

deliberate_omissions.other_source_structures: held out (would need a configurable scaffold)

estimands: original and neutralised channels (margins in three forms and both clocks, detached fractions, flux, expected relations, handover and partner indices) and their differences; T7/T8 checks
initial_conditions: HELD start state (source triangle); reachable class
instrument_note: the neutralised kernel divides each attachment rate by prod over path components of m^(internal witnesses) (= m^2), on formations for path_form and dissolutions for path_dissolve. It is not a grammar rule and not label-covariant; it is a counterfactual instrument to measure the share of an effect produced by the held triangle's own witnesses
open_questions_without_prediction: How much of each path family's attachment deficit (relative to the size-specific null) does the source-witness floor account for?
Does any sigma>0 family (path_form suppress, path_dissolve favour, CSPH, CWPH) gather once the floor is removed, in any form or clock?
Do the handover index, partner index and flux change, given that the affinities do not?

pre_freeze_exposure.e3a: all E3A results read (they motivate E3B)
pre_freeze_exposure.published: the original kernels of HELD N=5/6 PATHF and PATHH weak grades, CSPH, CWPH, PCOMP, CLOSEW and NULL are published (E0A/E0B/E1/E2A); their standard channels are known. No neutralised kernel was computed before freezing; plumbing tests use HELD N=4 only

question: Is the repulsion of the sigma>0 path families from the held source produced by the source triangle's own path witnesses (a constant, orientation-neutral floor), and does removing it change gathering?

stop_conditions.amendment: cell or estimand changes stop the round
stop_conditions.round: all items or 3600 s; then stop

work_count.estimate_note: two HELD N=6 kernels with GTH: about 2 minutes per N=6 cell
